RBAC verified: rep pawan.giri sees only own rows on /demands, /customers, /needs-review, /payments, /pipeline. Auth /me + /logout + PATCH /pipeline/{id} + PATCH /payments/{id}/reminder all green. Frontend: dev-login flow works (rohit1.singh), Dashboard renders SYNCED-Ns-AGO pill, Day/Month PeriodSelector, prev/next arrows + TODAY button, needs-review-cta shows count and navigates to /needs-review (40 rows visible as UNMATCHED cards with needs-review-back button); Customers tab shows 117 count in header + per-card period activity (Weight/Freight/Costing/GM2 + status badges like PLACED/UNKNOWN/PRICE MISMATCH); Pipeline tab shows 'NEW-ACQUISITION DEMAND ACTIVITY (LOGGED)' block above stage chips (All/Lead/Contacted/Demo/Negotiation/Won) with 47 deal cards grouped by stage. Only non-blocking issue is a pre-existing React Native web deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated (carryover from iter 2-5).

react_native_issues.issue: Browser console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking on web preview; will show as yellow warning in Metro. Search for pointerEvents= prop on Pressable/View in app/login.tsx and any tab bar wrappers and move it into style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' | 'auto' }}. Reference: seen on initial load of /login and persisting after nav.

action_items: (optional / non-blocking) Migrate any remaining props.pointerEvents usages to style.pointerEvents to silence the RN-Web deprecation warning.
(optional carryover) server.py is ~840 lines — consider splitting into auth/sync/dashboard modules for maintainability.

(nice-to-have) Add a top-level testID on the tab bar buttons (e.g. testID='tab-customers', testID='tab-pipeline') to make automated navigation more robust; today only card/chip/CTA testIDs exist and testing has to use router.push() URLs to switch tabs.

(informational) Live sheet numbers on 2026-08-13 currently show existing=175 / needs_review=24 (not 218/40 as noted in the review request context). The 218/40 figures match today's ref_date 2026-08-26 (visible in the dashboard screenshot). This is expected drift — the sheet grows day-by-day — and is NOT a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:239-447 sync_from_sheets: wipe-then-insert per-collection is fine at current volume (~200 demands / 117 active / 47 deals), but not concurrency-safe. A second /api/sync landing while the first is still running would double-insert and inflate counts. Consider wrapping in an asyncio.Lock or an idempotency flag in db.sync_log.

server.py:270-278 reminder_flags is keyed on (salesperson_email, customer) but payment rows are keyed by invoice_no in the sheet. If the same customer has multiple invoices, the newest reminder_sent_at wins and older ones lose their flag. Consider keying on (email, invoice_no).

sheets.py:157-170 classify_demand — new_acquisition_pattern strictly matches 'New Acquisition <Month>' with optional surrounding whitespace. Verified via unit test. Case-insensitive, extra whitespace tolerated.
sheets.py:246-278 parse_pipeline correctly skips Stage='Dropped' rows and maps Meeting Pending→Lead, Demo Done→Demo, Acquired→Won. Verified: no Dropped rows leak into /api/pipeline (0 in 47 deals).

server.py:487-603 dashboard endpoint pulls MTD rows twice (demand_q for selected period + mtd_rows for month-to-date placement + trend). For day period with ref_date far from month-start this doubles work; consider caching mtd_rows once.

server.py:641 /api/customers builds per_cust dict keyed by customer.lower() then re-lookups. Correctness OK; sort key uses (last_demand_date, forecast) descending which surfaces active customers first.
